profile.headline: Software Engineer, Meta Superintelligence Labs at Meta
profile.summary: Software engineer with a focus on augmented and virtual reality

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architect and developer of the Overmatch “Revolution Platform,”  a device-agnostic platform  for real-time multi-user ar/vr simulations that runs on PC, Mac, Linux, Magic Leap, Hololens 2, Quest 2, and iOS. The platform is primarily in C# on top of the Unity engine, with additional features implemented in C++ with C# wrappers.
• Lead developer of SRCE, an application built  on Revolution Platform to train first responders in a variety of high pressure scenarios.
• As first employee, took on all responsibilities of growing the engineering organization. Grew the team from 1 to 9 engineers, and built high functioning teams to help build Revolution Platform and SRCE. Worked directly with company executives to ensure that engineers are all getting opportunities needed for career growth, and advocated for new workflows as the team has grown and old workflows were no longer sufficient.
positions.insights: Skills: Augmented Reality (AR) · C++ · Unity · Virtual Reality (VR) · C#

positions.title: Spatial Computing Consultant
positions.description:
Helping teams design, prototype, and build augmented reality and spatial computing products. Experience with ARKit, AR Core, and the Magic Leap One
• Worked with Extality, Inc to design, develop, and ship version 2.0 of the CNN app for Magic Leap One.
positions.insights: Skills: Augmented Reality (AR) · Consulting · C++ · Unity · C#

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
• Generalist game developer on a geographically distributed team of 3. Primary responsibility as a software engineer, but frequently worked on design and occasionally on art.
• Co-designed and developed Monsters & Monocles, an online four player twin stick shooter for Steam and PS4. Implemented and maintained all of the game code, tools, and platform integrations.
• Created an alternative asset pipeline for Unity that allows for runtime loading of assets and player modifications. Built content creation and validation tools for several new asset types like the procedural map assets, enemy encounter tables, sprite animations, and audio cues.
• Designed and implemented a peer to peer multiplayer networking API for Unity that targets Steam and PS4.
• Prototyped several new game ideas in both Unity and Unreal Engine for evaluation.
• Developed shaders for and helped solve Unity technical issues on multiple mobile titles.

positions.title: Independent Developer & Consultant
positions.description: I work with clients throughout the entire development process to help design, implement, test, and release their mobile games. In past projects I have developed game engines to client specifications in C++ and Objective-C, and I also have over 3 years of experience using Unity to ship games across a variety of platforms.

positions.title: Founder and President
positions.description:
Creating fun game experiences for players of all ages across multiple platforms.  Initial products are focusing on iOS, Android, and Facebook.

While running Mirror Match I oversaw the development and shipping of multiple asynchronous multiplayer titles and developed the core of both the client and the server functionality. The games were deployed to iOS and Android.

positions.title: Vice President: Studio
positions.description:
At Muteki I oversaw multiple projects for clients as well as internal game development efforts. We shipped titles for ngmoco:) (now DeNA), Tapulous (now part of Disney), Electronic Arts, and more.

I was lead engineer on the 2009 Apple Design Award winning game Topple 2 for ngmoco:) and was honored when Fast Company named us one of the 10 most innovative companies in the game industry based on that work.

positions.title: Development Manager
positions.description: Acquired by Mercury Interactive in August '03
